category_title: Student with learning disabilities who whines and refuses to work
scenario_title: Independent difficult worksheet without teacher attention
minimal_context: Irene is assigned an independent math worksheet in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your math worksheet for today. Please complete these problems independently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whining) I don't want to do this math worksheet, it looks too hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the first problem and try your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it! I never get these right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need you to work on this by yourself for the next ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loudly pushes the desk) No! I'm not doing it! I'm not doing any of this work!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your math worksheet for today. Please complete these problems independently.

STUDENT: (Whining) I don't want to do this math worksheet, it looks too hard.

TUTOR: Just look at the first problem and try your best.

STUDENT: I can't do it! I never get these right.

TUTOR: I need you to work on this by yourself for the next ten minutes.

STUDENT: (Loudly pushes the desk) No! I'm not doing it! I'm not doing any of this work!

task.content: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets that are a hard task (unlikely to complete with 50% accuracy)

context.environment: Pull-out special education classroom at an elementary school
context.materials: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets, timers that buzzed on a fixed 1-min interval schedule
context.social_setting: Independent assignments during 10-minute brief analog FA trials

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When presented with difficult tasks and teacher attention was absent
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Whining, refusal to work, and loud disruptions during class time to avoid the work
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Repeated failure experienced across their schooling

behavior_patterns.condition: In the presence of challenging tasks
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Clear patterns of escaping difficult tasks, off-task and problem behavior
